key_idea: To construct a complete Kähler metric on a disc bundle using homogeneous peak polynomials that force logarithmic averages of the fiber capacity to diverge, thereby violating the Cauchy estimates required for a bounded map to have a non-vanishing Jacobian.
reason: The proof features a highly original and surprising analytic construction to control fiber geometry and obstruct biholomorphisms to bounded domains. However, its brilliant conceptual core requires substantial technical bookkeeping, including intricate metric tensor calculations and heavy analytical bounds.
